goal_intent: book one table for ten on Saturday evening

turns.utterance: Hi there! I’m calling to see if you have a table available for a little get-together I’m organizing this Saturday evening. It’s shaping up to be quite the gathering!
Absolutely, there will be ten of us. It’s been ages since we all got together, so we’re hoping to catch up in style!

Thanks for all those details, that sounds great! We’d like to arrive at 7:30pm—it gives everyone a chance to get ready and make their way over without rushing. And just to be clear, we’d all love to be seated together at one table if possible.

No, that covers everything I needed—thanks so much for your help! I’m looking forward to telling everyone it’s all sorted. Have a great day! 

[END OF CALL]
